Prerequisites: Dragoon 6

When you long jump a distance of 10 or more feet using a charge action, you may move after the attack, but your total distance that you can move cannot be greater than your speed. You can use Acrobatics skill checks to move through threatened squares in this manner at full speed without the imposed +10 DC modifier. You cannot use this ability to attack a foe that is adjacent to you at the start of your turn.
